verdict.rationale: Mailchimp advertises 'Generative AI features' and 'Analytics AI' that surface plain-language insights on campaign performance, suggesting some built-in AI capability, but there is no evidence of a conversational assistant to which users can delegate multi-step marketing tasks (e.g., building and sending a campaign autonomously). Missing for 10: documentation of an interactive AI assistant/agent, evidence of task delegation or autonomous execution, and independent corroboration of these AI features working as an assistant rather than static content-generation or reporting tools.
